info.title: ltx/ltx-video-to-video-reframe
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "ltx/ltx-video-to-video-reframe", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

post.summary: Queued-only: this route answers 403 not_enabled for ltx/ltx-video-to-video-reframe; use POST /v2/models/ltx/ltx-video-to-video-reframe/requests.

schema.description: Request body for `POST /proxy/ltx/v2/video-to-video-reframe`. On Comfy Router this model runs on the queued route only (`POST /v2/models/ltx/ltx-video-to-video-reframe/requests`): a job can outlast the time a synchronous call is held, so the synchronous route refuses it.

resolution.description: Target output resolution. The source video is extended to fill this frame.

video_uri.description: Input video as a publicly accessible HTTPS URL or a base64 data URI. H.264 or HEVC in MP4, MOV or MKV, up to 200 MB by URL. At most 60 seconds and 1800 frames, with width and height between 64 and 4096 pixels.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description:
Comfy Router output schema for LTX Reframe and LTX Upscale: the terminal `LTXJobStatusResponse` poll document, forwarded unchanged. Both jobs are submit-and-poll and Router polls on the caller's behalf, so the body a caller receives is the finished job (`status: completed`) rather than the task handle the underlying submit returns.
The output video is at `result.video_url`, and `result` is only present on a completed job. Output URLs expire 24 hours after completion, so download promptly rather than storing the link. A failed job carries `error.type` and `error.message` instead of `result`.

result.description: Present when status is completed; output URLs expire 24 hours after completion

LTXVideoReframePlacement.description: Where the source video sits in the output frame. Send either `anchor`, or `x` and `y` with `width`, `height` or both. Omit `placement` to center the video at the largest size that fits.

anchor.description: Edge or corner of the output frame the video is placed against.

height.description: Height of the placed video, as a fraction of the output height.

width.description: Width of the placed video, as a fraction of the output width.

x.description: Left edge of the placed video, as a fraction of the output width.

y.description: Top edge of the placed video, as a fraction of the output height.
